mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders( orders_type, orders_date, orders_time, total_price, payment_type, paid, orders_code, customer_name, customer_phone, customer_address, table_id ) VALUES ( #{ordersType}, #{ordersDate}, #{ordersTime}, #{totalPrice}, #{paymentType}, #{paid}, #{ordersCode}, #{customerName}, #{customerPhone}, #{customerAddress}, #{tableId} )

INSERT INTO order_details ( order_details_id, order_details, order_details_price, orders_id, setting_id ) VALUES ( #{orderDetailsId}, #{orderDetails}, #{orderDetailsPrice}, #{ordersId}, #{settingId} )
